title: VC Generates Alpha
primary_theme: Generating venture alpha through manager selection, alignment, and university innovation
founder_lessons: Use venture capital to access the innovation economy, especially when your institution has a structural technology network advantage.
Judge managers by fund size, portfolio construction, and risk-adjusted return potential, not just market beta.
Align incentives through meaningful GP commitment relative to the manager's actual liquid net worth.
Remember that returns to an endowment can become research, aid, and broader social impact.
notable_quotes: Venture capital, we think, is the best way to play the innovation economy.
CMU had the first ever undergraduate program for artificial intelligence.
inclusion and access is everything for us and CMU.
